description: Floods - Southern Malawi - March 2019 is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Netherlands Red Cross - 510. For the floods in Southern Malawi of March 2019, we have combined flood extent maps (Sentinel) with HRSL settlement/population grid. This results in a calculation of of affected buildings/people per district. The results is shared through maps and in a shapefile. 1. Coverage: Malawi. The portal files it under the publisher Netherlands Red Cross - 510. Its tags are geodata. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, PDF, SHP. The portal shows 2024-06-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
